segments.text: If you're like hyper-focused and you're just like, it's the time and the effort, you can make really, really fast progress.

So one of the things that I always like, I, I've believed in for a long time is that if you, if you really like invest lots of time, lots of effort, you go the extra mile, you go the extra 10 miles and you're like constantly overdoing things,
then you will improve faster than anybody else by many times.
And a lot of other people, maybe they're just not going the extra mile,
or maybe they're just not as focused, or, you know, they're...
I definitely, like, for a lot of what I attribute being able to accomplish so much to
is really about focus and overdoing it, going the extra mile.
That's what I think it boils down to.
